statements.statement: The select board adopted a goal objective to formalize a comprehensive FY27 budget plan through tri-board meetings, including the potential of town and school Proposition 2½ overrides, which may be tiered by level of necessity.

The town manager said the town's draft DLS-assisted financial policies need review before adoption because some best-practice provisions don't allow flexibility for changing circumstances, especially around the treatment and use of free cash.

warnings.about: town and school budget funding capacity for FY27
warnings.condition: if the current funding structure does not support identified needs
warnings.prediction: the town may end up needing a Proposition 2½ override as a last resort

warnings.condition: contingent on securing funding, likely at the fall special town meeting
warnings.prediction: a professional compensation and classification study could be completed by around May
